recordedFrom: 015d0a5 (pre-extraction interceptor, M1 step 2); the M1 step 5 re-record changed only routing_decision audit outcome success->noop in 7 passthrough scenarios; M6 (Free 2.3.0) re-record: owner pins moved below protected user selection (R1), so the two active-owner-override scenarios now read the session store (emitting session_pin_store_absent + warn) before the pin applies — the pin's routing_log, routing.decision audit and hook return value are unchanged; M6 T4 re-record: `family:` configured routes now resolve through the lineage resolver, so the 'configured mode, family alias' scenario (family:flash, an invalid lineage) is a loud 'family route unresolved' passthrough instead of the old 'family aliases require ToggleLogic Intelligence' no-op; M6 T6 re-record: the routing hook now emits a one-shot owner_pin_change audit event on the first decision that observes an owner-pin file version, so the three owner-override scenarios gain that record before their routing.decision; M6 T7 re-record: every routing record now carries the full pins snapshot (§4.5), so each scenario's routing_log gains a `pins` field; M6 T9 re-record (§5.3 pin failover): the 'owner override with provider override, provider down' scenario now fails over loudly to a host-configured fallback (provider_unavailable) instead of serving the pinned ref to the down provider — its pin is reported pins.all.status not_applied/unavailable with the pin surfaced in selectionDetails; no other scenario changed
